messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PROD Alert: spike in 5xx and upstream timeouts for edge cluster 'prod-edge' across multiple regions. Trigger: 5xx_rate > 4% over 5m. Paging @ankit (oncall)
ankit (oncall): on it — acked. looking at graphs now (eu-west-1 first). any customer-reported errors yet?
emma (support): getting a handful of customer tickets for failed generation calls, mostly timeouts then 502s. Customers mention request ids like rid=aa3f...
sara (sre): joining. prometheus query shows envoy_cluster_5xx_rate{cluster="prod-edge"} jumped from 0.5% -> 7% at 12:07 UTC. latencies also up, upstream_pending_requests increased.
junaid (ingress): i can tail envoy stats on a host — running `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9001/stats | rg upstream_rq_5xx`
junaid (ingress): results: `cluster.prod-inference.upstream_rq_5xx: 243` on frontdoor-12. also seeing `upstream_rq_pending_total` climb.
michael (runtime): looks like a retry amplification loop maybe? whats the retry config on the route?
ankit (oncall): pulling envoy route config: `GET /config_dump` -> route for /v1/generate has `retry_policy: retry_on: 5xx, gateway-error, retriable-status-codes: [502,504], num_retries: 3`
sara (sre): that is aggressive for high QPS endpoint. also circuit breaker settings show `max_retries: 3`, but host circuit-breaker `max_connections` low on some shards. could be overload leading to 502s then retries amplify load.
ankit (oncall): can we temporarily reduce retries to 0 or 1 asap?
junaid (ingress): i can push a quick route patch to shadow the change then promote. proposing patch: set `num_retries: 0` and increase `max_connections` on prod-inference cluster to 20000 for short window.
michael (runtime): confirm rollback plan?
junaid (ingress): we can revert to previous config in 2 commands. change is safe and config hot-reloads. doing it now.
ops-rotation-bot: deploy-bot started a config update for route '/v1/generate' by junaid at 12:18 UTC — status: queued
ankit (oncall): :thumbsup:
ops-rotation-bot: deploy-bot applied config update on frontdoor-*. rollout 10% -> 50% in 2m -> 100% at 12:21 UTC
junaid (ingress): done — num_retries set to 0 across frontdoor. increased `max_connections` on prod-inference to 20k on frontdoor-12/13/14.
sara (sre): immediate signal: 5xx rate dropping in eu-west-1 to ~1.2% within 1 minute. latency tail also improving.
emma (support): customers reporting partial recovery, one ticket that got 200 after retry. posting to ticket queue.
michael (runtime): checking backend logs for influx — I see upstream overload logs and host ejections around 12:06-12:10: `health_check_failure` and subsequent 502s. suggests circuit breaker ejection was happening then retries made it worse.
sara (sre): action summary so far: 1) disabled route-level retries 2) bumped cluster connection limits 3) rolling config applied. Need to watch for error regression and ensure no silent request loss.
ankit (oncall): monitoring dashboards: global 5xx down from 6.8% -> 0.8% in 8 minutes. keep observing for 30m. will start lifting mitigations carefully.
emma (support): tentative customer impact: approx 12:05-12:22 UTC ~12k requests affected across customers, worst for 3 midmarket customers in EU with 5-10% error rates. flagged for CS outreach.
junaid (ingress): note: we saw host ejection loop because some inference pods exceeded connection and rq timeouts, healthcheck flapping. likely root cause upstream but config relaxed the pressure.
michael (runtime): i'll open a short-lived canary to slowly re-enable 1 retry on 10% of traffic after 30m to validate safe behavior.
sara (sre): recommend we also add a short-term rate limiter at the gateway for /v1/generate to cap bursts (e.g., 300r/s per route) until we root cause.
ankit (oncall): agree. can we add that without redeploying runtime? junaid?
junaid (ingress): yes, gateway rate limit patch is small. applying limiter to 20% first.
ops-rotation-bot: rate-limit patch applied (20% rollout) at 12:35 UTC
ankit (oncall): handing off to @sara (sre) for extended watch window and post-incident tasks at 12:40 UTC. I'm going to grab lunch and be reachable.
sara (sre): taking over. I'll own the incident bridge and timeline. Next steps: collect envoy config dumps, host ejection logs, kube events, and runtime stack traces for any pod OOMs or slow GC.
michael (runtime): logging request IDs that failed during interval, pushing to s3://redwood-incident-logs/1735550123/requests.log
emma (support): creating outbound comms draft for affected customers, cc:security & cs.
sara (sre): quick addendum — any deploys around 12:00 UTC? ops-rotation-bot: recent releases: infra/metrics at 11:47 UTC, model-serving config rolled at 09:10 UTC. no config changes in the 12:00 window.
michael (runtime): collecting heap/metrics from inference pods. dumping `pstack` for one heavily-hit pod.
```
# sample commands
kubectl -n inference logs pod/infer-24 -c runtime --since=30m | rg "ERROR|timeout|502"
kubectl -n inference get events --field-selector lastTimestamp>2024-05-12T12:00:00Z
```

sara (sre): okay, we have a mitigation timeline and initial customer impact. i'll keep the thread updated every 10m. please post any new anomalies here. after 60m we'll decide whether to reopen retries with stricter host ejection thresholds.
ankit (oncall): thx all — nice quick mitigation.
emma (support): tickets updated, customers contacted with interim update.
junaid (ingress): will follow up with config diff and exact commands in the incident doc.
sara (sre): follow-ups assigned: - root cause analysis (michael, junaid) - postmortem writeup (sara) - customer RCA summary (emma)
sara (sre): linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/edge-retry-cb.json and incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1735550123
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. severity: Sev2. paging cleared for @ankit (oncall) at 12:42 UTC
sara (sre): closing note: regression appears to be configuration + upstream capacity fragility. mitigation effective. next: reproduce host ejection in staging, add guardrails to retries, and tune circuit-breaker thresholds in prod.
